'''Uvqolo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Extok Evin|Brother Extok Evin]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Vortex Squadron]] tasked a [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] with locating Master Inquisitor Uvqolo in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]], and [[Death/Legends|terminating]] him. Uvqolo, who was [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] a [[TIE/ag "Aggressor" Starfighter/Legends|TIE/AG Aggressor starfighter]] alongside an escort of four [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and two [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]], engaged the Rebel pilot in a heated [[Starfighter combat/Legends|skirmish]]. However, they were outmatched by the Vortex Squadron pilot's skill, who managed to destroy them all.<ref name="JTL" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ImperialInquisitorJTL.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Master Inquisitor Uvqolo]]
Uvqolo was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], the [[2004]] expansion pack for the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="JTL" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Uvqolo would taunt the player via comm display during combat, allowing the player to view his physical characteristics. Because Uvqolo's appearance was generated under the "imperial_inquisitor" template, he would either appear as a [[Human/Legends|Human]] male or as a male [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]].<ref name="JTL" />
